# 1 Enoch Chapter 54 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 54:5 — "abyss of complete condemnation" vs. "abyss of absolute condemnation"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "abyss of-complete-condemnation" | Literal; Ge'ez term = totality |
| LOGOS | "abyss of complete condemnation" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "abyss of absolute condemnation" | "Absolute" emphasizes irrevocability |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Abyss of complete condemnation" (LOGOS). "Complete" renders the Ge'ez totality sense well. "Absolute" (PNEUMA) imports a philosophical nuance.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 54:5 — "their jaws shall be covered with rough stones" — the binding image

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "they-shall-cover-their-jaws-with-rough-stones" | Literal; active construction |
| LOGOS | "their jaws shall be covered with rough stones" | Passive; same meaning |
| PNEUMA | "their mouths packed with rough stones" | "Mouths" for "jaws"; "packed" for vivid effect |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Their jaws shall be covered with rough stones" (LOGOS). "Jaws" is the more precise Ge'ez term (ʿengadt). "Mouths" (PNEUMA) is too general. "Covered" preserves the silencing/sealing image.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 54:6 — "becoming subjects of Satan" vs. "submitting to Satan"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "in-becoming-subject-to-Satan" | Literal; theological statement |
| LOGOS | "in becoming subjects of Satan" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "for submitting to Satan" | "Submitting" is active rather than resultant |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "In becoming subjects of Satan" (LOGOS). The Ge'ez describes the state they entered into — subject status — not merely the act of submission.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 54:10 — "recognized their unrighteousness" vs. "acknowledged" vs. "confess"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "recognized-their-unrighteousness" | Literal cognitive term |
| LOGOS | "acknowledged their unrighteousness" | Implies both recognition and admission |
| PNEUMA | "confess the wrongs" | "Confess" has sacramental overtones |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Acknowledged their unrighteousness" (LOGOS). "Recognized" (EMET) is purely cognitive; "confess" (PNEUMA) imports religious vocabulary. "Acknowledged" covers both recognition and admission, matching the Ge'ez.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements: 4**
